revision_manifest.goal: Operationalize the three critical revisions and incorporate post-implementation lessons: (1) explicit Convergence Boundary detection algorithms, (2) controlled empirical Utility(d) benchmark, (3) fully isolated standalone AI architecture free of Library ontology, plus new requirements for unsupervised basin robustness and mandatory ontology-free contracts.
revision_manifest.guiding_principle: Every change must turn a formal or asymptotic claim into a falsifiable, implementable, ontology-independent artifact. After actual use of the methodology, the standalone reference implementation is now treated as the primary scientific object.
global_constraints: Do not introduce new metaphysical commitments.
All new algorithms and data structures must be expressible with only NumPy + Python stdlib (or equivalent).
Preserve the paper’s existing mathematical notation where possible; extend rather than replace.
Every new subsection must contain at least one explicit, runnable pseudocode or reference to a concrete interface.
The navigation claim must remain fully testable even when every Library-derived term is deleted from the codebase.

required_updates.title: The Convergence Boundary as a Region of Inevitable Convergence
required_updates.rationale: The formal definition is elegant but non-operational. After implementation it became clear that destination-entropy detection is also brittle to the quality of basin labels; unsupervised basin discovery is therefore required for robustness.
required_updates.how_to_update: Insert subsection 7.3.1 'Operational Detection Algorithms' with the three detectors (Multi-path Destination Entropy, Symbolic Poincaré-Recurrence, Adaptive Lyapunov Shear). Add a new 7.3.2 'Unsupervised Basin Robustness' that requires any production detector to function without oracle basin_hint labels, or to include an explicit unsupervised basin-discovery pre-step.
required_updates.poetic_cipher: A boundary drawn in sand disappears when the tide of labels turns.
required_updates.cipher_explanation: Detection that depends on perfect basin labels is only as strong as the labelling process. The methodology must survive noisy or missing labels.

guideposts_for_editor.must_not: Claim any detector is optimal; present them as falsifiable candidates.

supporting_references: Poincaré recurrence algorithms for high-dimensional attractors

required_updates.title: Illustrative Data Structures + Architectural Pseudocode
required_updates.rationale: Ontology leakage into interfaces was observed during implementation. The four core classes must be the primary artifact and must carry an explicit ontology-free contract.
required_updates.how_to_update: Replace/augment with the clean specification of Guidepost, GuidepostStore, CoherentNavigator, BoundaryEvent. Elevate the standalone implementation to primary status. Add an explicit 'Ontology-Free Mode' contract paragraph stating that the navigation claim remains valid and testable when all Library terms are removed.
required_updates.poetic_cipher: The map that still needs the territory is not yet a map.
required_updates.cipher_explanation: If the code cannot run without the metaphysical scaffolding, the architecture has not been isolated.

guideposts_for_editor.reference_code: Exact classes from standalone_coherent_navigation.py (Library comments stripped)
guideposts_for_editor.isolation_statement: The interfaces are self-contained and make no reference to static totality, Library, or any ontological substrate beyond ordinary computational objects. This is now a mandatory contract.

required_updates.title: Dimensionality and Navigation Cost Tradeoff
required_updates.rationale: Asymptotic Utility is insufficient. Implementation revealed that the existence and width of the plateau are highly sensitive to the data-generation process; this sensitivity must be acknowledged and measured.
required_updates.how_to_update: Split into 15.3.1 (formal definition) and 15.3.2 (Controlled Benchmark Protocol). In 15.3.2 require publication of the full empirical U(d) surface, the location of d_opt, plateau width, and an explicit statement of sensitivity to the synthetic generative process.
required_updates.poetic_cipher: A peak that vanishes when the ground shifts was never a mountain.
required_updates.cipher_explanation: The optimal dimensionality is not a universal constant; it is conditioned on the structure of the data. The paper must show the surface, not merely assert a peak.

guideposts_for_editor.required_output: Heat-map + argmax + plateau width + sensitivity note
guideposts_for_editor.reference_implementation: measure_utility() and the cardinality × dimensionality sweep
guideposts_for_editor.falsifiability_clause: Absence of a usable plateau under the defined protocol falsifies the dimensionality-optimality claim for that regime.

supporting_references: Standard fidelity–cost reporting practice in representation learning

required_updates.title: Testable Predictions
required_updates.rationale: Predictions must now be tied to the concrete detectors, the Utility surface, and the ontology-free contract so that independent replication is possible.
required_updates.how_to_update: Rewrite every prediction to name either a detector from 7.3.1 or a measurable quantity from 15.3.2. Add: (a) a usable plateau in U(d) will appear for at least one (α,β) pair; (b) the core navigation logic remains functional under strict ontology-free mode.
required_updates.poetic_cipher: A prediction that cannot be weighed is only a wish.
required_updates.cipher_explanation: After implementation, every claim must point to a procedure that a third party can execute without accepting the broader ontology.

guideposts_for_editor.make_each_prediction: quantified and tied to an explicit experimental procedure
guideposts_for_editor.remove: any prediction that cannot be evaluated with the standalone implementation alone

required_updates.title: Empirical Evaluation Criteria
required_updates.rationale: Must now enforce both the Utility surface and the ontology-isolation requirement as first-class evaluation criteria.
required_updates.how_to_update: Add: 6. Ontology Isolation (core logic must run with only the standalone modules); 7. Utility Surface (empirical U(d) must be published; missing plateau is a negative result); 8. Basin-label robustness (detectors must be evaluated with and without oracle basin hints).
required_updates.poetic_cipher: The test that still needs the temple is not yet a test.
required_updates.cipher_explanation: Evaluation criteria themselves must be free of the ontology they claim to transcend.

required_updates.title: Architectural Flow Summary
required_updates.rationale: The flow must reflect the new mandatory components discovered through use: boundary detection, Utility evaluation, and ontology-free execution path.
required_updates.how_to_update: Insert 'Boundary Detector', 'Utility Evaluator', and an explicit 'Ontology-Free Execution Path' into the flow diagram and prose. State that all three are required for any claim of practical viability.
required_updates.poetic_cipher: A river that forgets its own banks floods the map.
required_updates.cipher_explanation: The architectural summary must now contain every checkpoint that implementation proved necessary.

guideposts_for_editor.flow_order: Guidepost construction → Multi-path descent → Boundary detection → Reconstruction → Utility measurement (all runnable in ontology-free mode)

required_updates.title: Top-level consistency pass
required_updates.rationale: After implementation experience, the top-level statements must acknowledge that Convergence Boundary membership is an observable runtime property and that the architecture carries an ontology-free contract.
required_updates.how_to_update: In the abstract, replace pure asymptotic language with: 'The architecture is supplied with concrete detection algorithms, an empirical Utility(d) protocol, and an explicit ontology-free contract that together permit independent falsification.' In _core_thesis add: 'Convergence Boundary membership is an observable runtime property' and 'The navigation claim is required to remain valid under strict ontology-free execution.' Update _formal_summary.convergence with the destination-entropy criterion.
required_updates.poetic_cipher: The claim that still hides behind the mountain cannot be climbed.
required_updates.cipher_explanation: Top-level statements must now reflect what was learned by actually walking the path.

guideposts_for_editor.tone: minimal wording changes; preserve all existing formal statements

required_updates.subsection: Post-Implementation Lessons (recommended new short section or appendix to 15)
required_updates.title: Lessons from Operational Use
required_updates.rationale: Having exercised the methodology revealed three concrete failure modes and corresponding hardening requirements that the original draft could not have known.
required_updates.how_to_update: Add a concise subsection (or appendix) that records: (1) ontology leakage into interfaces, (2) brittleness of destination entropy to basin-label quality, (3) sensitivity of the Utility plateau to data generation. For each, state the mitigation now required.
required_updates.poetic_cipher: The map improves only after the traveler returns with torn boots.
required_updates.cipher_explanation: Experience of use is itself data. The paper should incorporate what broke when the methodology was actually run.

delivery_checklist_for_editing_ai: The paper must contain a complete, copy-pasteable reference implementation of the four core classes treated as the primary artifact.
Section 7.3 must contain three named detectors plus an unsupervised-basin robustness requirement.
Section 15.3 must contain an explicit experimental protocol that produces and publishes a U(d) surface, including plateau-width and sensitivity notes.
An explicit Ontology-Free Mode contract must appear in the architecture section and be referenced from evaluation criteria.
No remaining sentence may imply that the navigation claim depends on acceptance of the Library ontology.
All new code and pseudocode must be executable with only NumPy and the Python standard library.
A short 'Lessons from Operational Use' record must capture the three failure modes discovered through actual implementation.

artifacts_to_reuse.standalone_implementation: standalone_coherent_navigation.py (Guidepost, GuidepostStore, CoherentNavigator, BoundaryEvent, measure_utility) — now elevated to primary scientific object
artifacts_to_reuse.benchmark_skeleton: the cardinality × dimensionality sweep and Utility calculation defined earlier
